$comment: Advisory patterns for cratis-pattern-scan.sh. Each entry: id; files and exclude (extended regular expressions matched against the repository-relative path); pattern, requires and absent (extended regular expressions matched against the file with comment lines removed and lines joined: the entry fires when pattern and requires match and absent does not); message (one line); enabled (false silences the entry).

patterns.message: A command `Handle` or `Provide` that takes `IEventLog` bypasses Arc's append pipeline (analyzer ARCCHR0007). Return the event, an `IEnumerable<object>` or `EventForEventSourceId` wrappers instead; use `IEventLog.Transactional` only when returning events is not possible.

Cratis application slices are model-bound by convention: a `[Command]` record with `Handle()` and query methods on a `[ReadModel]` record, with Arc generating the endpoints. Keep this controller only if the repository already uses controller-based endpoints here.

Arc reads a custom path for a model-bound read model or query method from `[Path("...")]` (`Cratis.Arc.Queries.ModelBound`), not from `[Route]`; `[Route]` only affects controllers. Ignore this if the `[Route]` sits on a controller in the same file.

With `@cratis/components` 4, use `Dialog` from `@cratis/components/Dialogs` or `CommandDialog` from `@cratis/components/CommandDialog` instead of `primereact/dialog`. Ignore this where the application deliberately renders its own PrimeReact dialog.
`.AutoMap()` is redundant: Chronicle projections map same-named properties by default (analyzer CHR0028). Remove the call unless it re-enables mapping after `.NoAutoMap()`.
